subject.why: The image clearly shows an open, tilted red umbrella with a curved wooden handle and the requested dangling heart charm.

category.why: The umbrella floats freely with no ground or surface, set against a saturated gradient background with radiating sunburst rays.

clean.why: There are no text, UI elements, watermarks, frames, or characters present.

framing.why: The umbrella is well-centered with ample margins on all sides and nothing clipped.

colour.why: The red canopy contrasts sharply and vibrantly against the bright blue background.

detail.why: The forms are simplified with clean, bold volumes and no distracting micro-textures or unnecessary props.

style.why: The rendering matches the references with chunky 3D forms, soft satin shading, and smooth lighting without outlines.
